[Shot 1] The video starts exactly from the frame of <Picture 1>. <Subject 1> is standing on the rooftop, holding <Subject 2> near the lapel of her black blazer. The camera performs a gradual Push In with small amplitude at a slow speed. <Subject 1> looks down at <Subject 2>, checks the exposed coral bullet, and twists the gold base downward until it clicks shut. Her blonde hair sweeps across her face, fluttering in the wind as she maintains her balance.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to a medium shot as the camera performs a smooth Tracking Shot, panning right to follow <Subject 1> as she walks toward the low concrete ledge of the rooftop. She reaches for the coral flower on her blazer, removes it, and sets it gently on the concrete beside <Subject 2>. Suddenly, a strong gust of wind nudges both the flower and the lipstick across the rough concrete surface. <Subject 1> quickly reaches down to recover them, her expression shifting to a light, amused reaction.

[Shot 3] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a Static Shot, a wide lock-off view of the rooftop. <Subject 1> settles back against the railing, secures the coral flower back onto her coat, and raises <Subject 2> toward the distant city skyline. She then lowers the lipstick, turns her head toward the camera with an irrepressible, genuine smile, and takes one final step forward into the warm breeze. Her hair and the edges of her black blazer flutter continuously. In the background, a distant train is visible, flashing and moving along the tracks below the rooftop level.

The soundscape is dominated by the ambient roar of open rooftop wind and distant city traffic. Specific foley includes the metallic twist and audible "click" of <Subject 2> closing, the scraping sound of the lipstick and flower being pushed across the concrete ledge, and the distant, rhythmic rattling of a passing train. <Subject 1> lets out a soft, light laugh during the wind gust.
